summary: Iteration 2 focus: new POST /api/cleanup endpoint + review-screen AI Cleanup UI (code review only, review screen is unreachable headlessly). Backend: 20/20 pytest tests pass (16 regression + 4 new cleanup). Cleanup happy path with mixed BN+EN OCR ('Hell0 w0rld thls is a testt. আমি বাংলাय় লিখছ i') returns clean text 'Hello world this is a test. আমি বাংলায় লিখছি।' — Latin errors fixed, Bengali script normalized (including trailing 'i' → 'ি' matra + 'দাঁড়ি' punctuation), no commentary preamble. Empty and whitespace-only text correctly return 400 with detail 'No text to clean up'. Missing 'text' field returns 422 (Pydantic). Regression: /api/quality-check, /api/extract, /api/history, /api/append-docx, /api/download all green. Home screen smoke: renders LipiScan title, subtitle, empty state and New Scan FAB. Code review of app/review.tsx: AI Cleanup button correctly disabled when text is empty or mutation pending; Undo button replaces Cleanup button only after a successful cleanup (prevText !== null); inline error text rendered from mutation.onError; router.replace('/camera') is now correctly wrapped in useEffect (regression from iteration 1 fixed).
action_items: Environment note (already mitigated by testing agent): the container was missing the `tesseract-ocr`, `tesseract-ocr-ben`, `tesseract-ocr-eng` system packages, causing /api/quality-check and /api/extract to return 500 with 'TesseractNotFoundError'. Testing agent ran `apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-ben tesseract-ocr-eng` and re-verified. Main agent should ensure these are pinned in the Dockerfile / bootstrap script so they survive fresh container builds.
Optional (carried from iteration 1): replace deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') with FastAPI lifespan handler in backend/server.py.
critical_code_review_comments: app/review.tsx cleanup mutation: constructs URL as `${API_BASE}/cleanup` (correct — API_BASE already includes /api). Uses fetch directly instead of the shared postForm/postJson helper — minor inconsistency but functionally fine.

app/review.tsx: cleanupError is cleared only on next successful cleanup — it stays visible if user edits the text and retries. Consider clearing on onChangeText or when opening a new mutation. Reference: /app/frontend/app/review.tsx:23,49

app/review.tsx: Undo only restores the single previous state (no multi-level history) which matches spec, but once undone, prevText is set back to null so a re-cleanup discards the undone state without confirmation — acceptable.
backend/server.py:213 uses model 'openai/gpt-5.4'. Confirm this is intentional — Emergent LLM allowed models list should include gpt-5.4.
backend/server.py cleanup endpoint has no size guard on input; a very large OCR blob could exceed the LLM's context / rack up tokens. Consider a max length (e.g. 10 KB) with 413 response.
seed_data_creation: Cleanup tests do not create DB rows. Extract-history tests create/soft-delete ephemeral test records as before.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tesseract system binary must be installed (tesseract-ocr + tesseract-ocr-ben + tesseract-ocr-eng) for /api/quality-check and /api/extract. /api/cleanup uses emergentintegrations LlmChat with model openai/gpt-5.4 and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY from backend/.env. Cleanup calls take ~1-3s each — tests use timeout=60. Review screen is guarded by session.photoUri (in-memory) so it redirects to /camera in headless browsers; code review only for that screen.
rca_of_issue: Initial pytest run showed 6/20 failures on quality-check/extract endpoints with backend HTTP 500. Root cause traced from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log: pytesseract.TesseractNotFoundError — the tesseract binary was absent from PATH in the fresh container. Installed via `apt-get install -y tesseract-ocr tesseract-ocr-ben tesseract-ocr-eng`; confirmed `tesseract --list-langs` shows ben, eng, osd. Re-ran full suite: 20/20 passed. This was an environment provisioning gap, not a code bug — but main agent should ensure the container image / setup script installs these packages so the app boots healthy on any fresh spin-up.
